AGRICULTURAL HOLDINGS (OPTION TO
PURCHASE) (FEES) REGULATIONS, 1985 1985/108.
Authority: These regulations were made on 4th April, 1985 by the Cabinet under
section 10 of the Agricultural Holdings (Option to Purchase) Act.
Commencement: 4th April, 1985.
1. These Regulations may be cited as the Agricultural
Holdings (Option to Purchase) (Fees) Regulations, 1985.
2. The fees payable under these regulations are set out in the
Schedule. Schedule.
SCHEDULE
(Regulation 2)
1. For the preparation and completion of a
conveyance for the sale of an
agricultural holding under the Act . . . . . . $10 or 1% of the considera-
tion whichever is the
greater
2. For the perusal of a conveyance for the
sale of an agricultural holding under
the Act .., .. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .. . $10 or 1% of the consider-
ation whichever is the
greater
3. For an application to the High Court for
the variation of an agreement relating
to the price of an agricultural holding .. . The rate applicable for
the filing of cases in the
High Court.
THE LAWS OF BARBADOS
